text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—On a day off.
Tonight, I was at an amusement park with
Duramente.
To enjoy the Halloween event!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Every corner of the park is decked out for
Halloween.
Everyone is in costume and having such a
wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to enjoy herself last
Halloween, so I asked
if she'd like to check out an amusement
park's Halloween
event, and she readily accepted.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's exceedingly crowded. In case we get
separated,
let us designate a meeting spot.
choice_data_list:
In that case, we can just message each
other—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No... well... our reception might drop.
Let us meet in the entrance hall of the
largest mansion,
at the deepest end of the Ghost Town area.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ghost parade has begun!
Spooks roam all across the park grounds,
frightening guests left and right.

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: AWOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer, a pack of werewolves has
arrived!
Sweets, apparently they will leave if we
give them sweets.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There is a candy cart over yonder.
Let us purchase some there!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer is currently paying.
Now is my chance to slip away unnoticed.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must finish my preparations
before
Trainer arrives at the meeting point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
『If you have no plans for your day off,
it's Halloween, so want to hit the
amusement park?』

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer decorated the entire office for
Halloween,
and went so far as to invite me all the
way to this park.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(It is clear that Trainer wishes to
experience
Halloween to its fullest.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The essence of Halloween lies in tricks.
I must respond in kind with a trick of my
own.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...First, I must find a hiding place.
The key was not letting the other person
suspect a thing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(From here, I can keep an eye on the
hallway through the crack
in the door. This should serve as an ideal
hiding spot.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(...Rattle)
『AHAHAHAHAHA!』

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...A-A doll?
Pay it no mind... Focus...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(When Trainer arrives, I shall spring my
trick.
Right now, I must focus entirely on
that...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Just as I was taught. Utilize the
atmosphere,
keep them in the dark, and embody Dracula
completely—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! —They're here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting separated from Duramente, I
made my way to
the entrance hall rendezvous point. But
with no sign of her,
I decided to check the hallways as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dimly lit hallway was eerily quiet.
I opened the door to a nearby room and
peeked inside, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Trick or trick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A chillingly cold hand brushed against the
nape of my neck.
At the same moment, a distinct click
resonated in the air.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Upon the pitiful human who has trespassed
into my domain,
I bestow the baptism of a trick.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That choker is proof of your servitude.
From this moment forth, you are my
familiar.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps I was once called by that name?
However, now I am your master.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You are granted but two choices.
Will you become my thrall? Or will you
offer up a sacrifice to me? Now, choose.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... You choose to become my thrall.
Very well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You shall share eternity with me.
choice_data_list: I swear to live eternity with you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, no vow is needed.
—I have no intention of letting you go,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente gave a bewitching smile.
As I stood there captivated—
she gave my forehead a gentle poke with
her fingertip.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Now then, as my thrall, continue to serve
me faithfully.
Do not fall behind—stay right at my side.
choice_data_list: Of course! I've always planned on that!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You truly are... Trainer through and
through.
—Ah, I broke character.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Now then—I shall partake of your blood.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, for that is a vampire's feast.
Come, offer it freely. Your crimson blood—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente gave a bewitching smile.
As I stood there captivated—
she gave my forehead a gentle poke with
her fingertip.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Henceforth, your blood belongs to me.
As my source of sustenance, you must keep
it delicious.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Stress spoils the flavor of blood.
For my sake, lead a healthy life.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Why are you staring blankly?
Was my trick lacking in some way?
choice_data_list:
No, it was so authentic that I got
completely drawn in...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
...Did you get to enjoy Halloween to the
fullest?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it was a thrilling, unforgettable
night!

Yep, it was a thrilling, unforgettable
night!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I never dreamed for a second that she
would play a trick on me.
Everything was entirely unexpected, and I
told her just how
much fun it was.
choice_data_list: Thank you for preparing such a trick!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Heh, to receive gratitude for playing a
trick.
And yet... I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Tricks are the essence of Halloween...
I feel as though I finally understand that
for myself.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Do not let your guard down next year
either.
